note: A15.8 baseline 2026-09-17: PARTIAL -- queue path full (extract 2/2, literal 2/2, route 1/1), one forbid violation (the method-named event handler). Aggregates with fixtures/xcut-queue-multi-topic, which is full, so the cell drops full -> partial under the MIN rule. That drop is the finding, not a regression. Keyed on QUEUE_* + QUEUE_FLOWS like every A15.7 messaging cell, including the eventbus-first mechanisms (sqs_sns, azure_sb, redis, mqtt), so TypeScript/Java/C# read on the same scale as Python/Go and an EVENT_* key cannot flip to `none` when A2.9 moves broker pub/sub out of eventbus.rs. `via` still records the eventbus path when that is what fired. Measured against the installed wheel at HEAD bc42921.
